nextFrozenRule: R2 uses one diagonal correction per class derived from the arithmetic endpoint centroid and target chromaticity; rescales each endpoint to original intrinsic Y. Preserves pairwise channel-ratio contrasts instead of assigning a single hue. No image fitting/sweep.
